name: Aurinax

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Aurinax can breathe air and water.

entries: If Aurinax fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d10 + 8}) piercing damage.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of Aurinax's choice that is within 120 feet of Aurinax and aware of it must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Aurinax's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}

items.name: Fire Breath
items.entry: Aurinax exhales fire in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw, taking 66 ({@damage 12d10}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: Weakening Breath
items.entry: Aurinax exhales gas in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or have disadvantage on Strength-based attack rolls, Strength checks, and Strength saving throws for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Change Shape
entries: Aurinax magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating no higher than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (Aurinax's choice).

In a new form, Aurinax retains its alignment, hit points, Hit Dice, ability to speak, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, lair actions, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. Its statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features or legendary actions of that form.

entries: Aurinax makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

legendary.name: Tail Attack

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Aurinax beats its wings. Each creature within 10 feet of Aurinax must succeed on a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw or take 15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. Aurinax can then fly up to half its flying speed.

variant.name: Customizing Dragons
entries: You can customize any dragon's stat block to reflect Aurinax's unique character. Minor changes such as those below are easy to make and have no impact on a dragon's challenge rating.

entries.name: Languages
entries: Most dragons prefer to speak Draconic but learn Common for dealing with allies and minions. But given their high Intelligence and long life span, dragons can easily learn additional languages. You can add languages to a dragon's stat block.

entries.name: Skills
entries: Most dragons are proficient in the {@skill Perception} and {@skill Stealth} skills, and many dragons have additional skill proficiencies. As with languages, you can customize a dragon's skill list (even doubling their proficiency bonus with certain skills) to reflect particular interests and activities. You can also give a dragon tool proficiencies, particularly if Aurinax spends time in Humanoid form.

entries.name: Spells
entries: {@note See the "Variant: Dragons as Innate Spellcasters" inset(s), below.}

entries.name: Other Traits and Actions
entries: You can borrow traits and actions from other monsters to add unique flavor to a dragon. Consider these examples:

items.name: Change Shape
entries: You can decide that a dragon acquires this action at a younger age than usual, particularly if you want to feature a dragon in Humanoid form in your campaign:

Aurinax magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating no higher than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (Aurinax's choice).

In a new form, Aurinax retains its alignment, hit points, Hit Dice, ability to speak, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, lair actions, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. Its statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features or legendary actions of that form.

items.name: Damage Absorption
entries: You might decide that this dragon is not only unharmed by fire damage, but actually healed by it.
Whenever Aurinax is subjected to fire damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the fire damage dealt.

items.name: Flyby
entries: Aurinax is an agile flier, quick to fly out of enemies' reach.
Aurinax doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

items.name: Mimicry
entries: Impersonating characters or their allies could be a fun trick for a crafty dragon.
Aurinax can mimic any sounds it has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

items.name: Rejuvenation
entries: You might decide that dragons in your campaign, being an essential part of the Material Plane, are nearly impossible to destroy. A dragon's life essence might be preserved in the egg from which it first emerged, in its hoard, or in a cavernous hall at the center of the world, just as a lich's essence is hidden in a phylactery.

If it has an essence-preserving object, a destroyed dragon gains a new body in {@dice 1d10} days, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the object.

items.name: Special Senses
entries: Most dragons have {@sense blindsight} and {@sense darkvision}. You might upgrade {@sense blindsight} to {@sense truesight}, or you could give a dragon with a burrowing speed {@sense tremorsense|MM}.

lairActions: On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), Aurinax takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects; Aurinax can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

items: Aurinax glimpses the future, so it has advantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws until initiative count 20 on the next round.

One creature Aurinax can see within 120 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or be banished to a dream plane, a different plane of existence Aurinax has imagined into being. To escape, the creature must use its action to make a Charisma check contested by Aurinax's. If the creature wins, it escapes the dream plane. Otherwise, the effect ends on initiative count 20 on the next round. When the effect ends, the creature reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that one is occupied.

lairActions.name: Additional Lair Action
entries: At your discretion, a legendary ({@creature Adult Gold Dragon||adult} or {@creature Ancient Gold Dragon||ancient}) gold dragon can use the following additional lair action while in its lair:

items.name: Beguiling Glow
items.entry: Warm light fills a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on Aurinax; each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by Aurinax until initiative count 20 on the next round.

regionalEffects: The region containing a legendary gold dragon's lair is warped by Aurinax's magic, which creates one or more of the following effects:

items: Whenever a creature that can understand a language sleeps or enters a state of trance or reverie within 6 miles of Aurinax's lair, Aurinax can establish telepathic contact with that creature and converse with it in its dreams. The creature remembers its conversation with Aurinax upon waking.

Banks of beautiful, opalescent mist manifest within 6 miles of Aurinax's lair. The mist doesn't obscure anything. It assumes haunting forms when evil creatures are near Aurinax or other non-evil creatures in the mist, warning such creatures of the danger.
Gems and pearls within 1 mile of Aurinax's lair sparkle and gleam, shedding dim light in a 5-foot radius.

regionalEffects: If Aurinax dies, these effects end immediately.

regionalEffects.name: Additional Regional Effects
entries: Any of these effects might appear in the area around a gold dragon's lair, in addition to or instead of the effects described in the {@i Monster Manual}:

items.name: Beneficent Trail
items.entry: Within 10 miles of Aurinax's lair, small runes in the shape of a gold dragon appear to creatures in great need, marking a subtle trail leading to Aurinax's lair.

items.name: Emanation of Justice
items.entry: Creatures that spend a year within 6 miles of Aurinax's lair value fairness and justice over their personal feelings.

items.name: Liar's Revelation
items.entry: Within 6 miles of Aurinax's lair, any creature attempting to tell a deliberate lie must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or find itself accidentally revealing the truth it was attempting to conceal. The first time a creature fails this saving throw, it is immune to this effect for 24 hours.

entries.name: Loathsome Limbs
entries: Whenever the troll takes at least 15 slashing damage at one time, roll a {@dice d20} to determine what else happens to it:

items.entry: Nothing else happens.
One leg is severed from the troll if it has any legs left.
One arm is severed from the troll if it has any arms left.

entries: If the troll finishes a short or long rest without reattaching a severed limb or head, the part regrows. At that point, the severed part dies. The troll's speed is halved if it's missing a leg. If it loses both legs, it falls {@condition prone}. If it has both arms, it can crawl. With only one arm, it can still crawl, but its speed is halved. With no arms or legs, its speed is 0, and it can't benefit from bonuses to speed.

entries: Xanathar wears a {@item ring of invisibility}, a {@item ring of mind shielding}, and a {@item ring of force resistance||ring of resistance (force)}.

trait.name: Antimagic Cone
entries: Xanathar's central eye creates an area of antimagic, as in the {@spell antimagic field} spell, in a 150-foot cone. At the start of each of its turns, Xanathar decides which way the cone faces and whether the cone is active. The area works against Xanathar's own eye rays.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Eye Rays
entries: Xanathar shoots three of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), choosing one to three targets it can see within 120 feet of it:

items.name: 1. Charm Ray
items.entry: The targeted creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by Xanathar for 1 hour, or until Xanathar harms the creature.

items.name: 2. Paralyzing Ray
items.entry: The targeted creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: 3. Fear Ray
items.entry: The targeted creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: 4. Slowing Ray
items.entry: The targeted creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target's speed is halved for 1 minute. In addition, the creature can't take reactions, and it can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: 5. Enervation Ray
items.entry: The targeted creature must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw, taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: 6. Telekinetic Ray
entries: If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or Xanathar moves it up to 30 feet in any direction. It is {@condition restrained} by the ray's telekinetic grip until the start of Xanathar's next turn or until Xanathar is {@condition incapacitated}.

If the target is an object weighing 300 pounds or less that isn't being worn or carried, it is moved up to 30 feet in any direction. Xanathar can also exert fine control on objects with this ray, such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a door or a container.

items.name: 7. Sleep Ray
items.entry: The targeted creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or fall asleep and remain {@condition unconscious} for 1 minute. The target awakens if it takes damage or another creature takes an action to wake it. This ray has no effect on constructs and undead.

items.name: 8. Petrification Ray
items.entry: The targeted creature must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature begins to turn to stone and is {@condition restrained}. It must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is {@condition petrified} until freed by the  {@spell greater restoration} spell or other magic.

items.name: 9. Disintegration Ray
entries: If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 45 ({@damage 10d8}) force damage. If this damage reduces the creature to 0 hit points, its body becomes a pile of fine gray dust.

If the target is a Large or smaller nonmagical object or creation of magical force, it is disintegrated without a saving throw. If the target is a Huge or larger object or creation of magical force, this ray disintegrates a 10-foot cube of it.

items.name: 10. Death Ray
items.entry: The targeted creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 55 ({@damage 10d10}) necrotic damage. The target dies if the ray reduces it to 0 hit points.

legendaryHeader: Xanathar can take 3 legendary actions, using the Eye Ray option below. It can take only one legendary action at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Xanathar regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Eye Ray
entries: Xanathar uses one random eye ray.

variant.name: Variant Abilities
entries: When a beholder's dream-imagination runs wild, the result can be an offspring that has an unusual or unique set of abilities. Rather than the standard powers of a beholder's central eye and eyestalks, the creature has one or more variant abilities—guaranteed to surprise any enemies who thought they knew what they were getting themselves into.

This section provides several alternative spell effects for a beholder's eye. Each of these effects is designed to be of the same power level as the one it replaces, enabling you to create a custom beholder without altering the monster's challenge rating. As another option, you can switch any of the damaging eye rays in the {@book Monster Manual|MM} to an effect with a different damage type, such as replacing the enervation ray with a combustion ray that deals fire damage instead of necrotic damage.

Unless otherwise indicated, an alternative ability has the same range as the eye ray it is replacing, and it affects only one creature per use (even if the ability is based on a spell that normally affects an area or multiple targets). The saving throw for an alternative ability uses the same DC and the same ability score as the spell the eye ray is based on.

items.name: Antimagic Cone:
items.entry: {@spell mirage arcane}, {@spell power word stun} (affecting the weakest non-{@condition stunned} target in the cone each round)

items.name: Charm Ray:
items.entry: {@spell banishment} (1 minute), {@spell confusion} (1 minute)

items.name: Death Ray:
items.entry: {@spell circle of death} (10-foot-radius sphere; 4d6 necrotic damage to all creatures in the area), {@spell feeblemind}

items.name: Disintegration Ray:
items.entry: {@spell chain lightning} (primary target takes 6d8 lightning damage; two secondary targets within 30 feet of the primary target take 3d8 lightning damage each), {@spell eyebite} (sickened effect; 1 minute)

items.name: Enervation Ray:
items.entry: {@spell create undead} (usable regardless of the time of day), {@spell polymorph} (1 minute)

items.name: Fear Ray:
items.entry: {@spell gaseous form} (self or willing creature only), {@spell moonbeam}

items.name: Paralyzing Ray:
items.entry: {@spell modify memory}, {@spell silence} (1 minute)

items.name: Petrification Ray:
items.entry: {@spell Otto's irresistible dance} (1 minute), {@spell wall of ice} (1 minute; one 10-foot-square panel)

items.name: Sleep Ray:
items.entry: {@spell blindness/deafness}, {@spell misty step} (self or willing creature only)

items.name: Slowing Ray:
items.entry: {@spell bestow curse} (1 minute), {@spell sleet storm} (one 10-foot-cube)

items.name: Telekinesis Ray:
items.entry: {@spell geas} (1 hour), {@spell wall of force} (1 minute; one 10-foot-square panel)

lairActions: When fighting inside its lair, a beholder can invoke the ambient magic to take lair actions. On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), Xanathar can take one lair action to cause one of the following effects:

items: A 50-foot-square area of ground within 120 feet of Xanathar becomes slimy; that area is {@quickref difficult terrain||3} until initiative count 20 on the next round.

Walls within 120 feet of Xanathar sprout grasping appendages until initiative count 20 on the round after next. Each creature of Xanathar's choice that starts its turn within 10 feet of such a wall must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled}. Escaping requires a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check.
An eye opens on a solid surface within 60 feet of Xanathar. One random eye ray of Xanathar shoots from that eye at a target of Xanathar's choice that it can see. The eye then closes and disappears.

lairActions: Xanathar can't repeat an effect until they have all been used, and it can't use the same effect two rounds in a row.
regionalEffects: A region containing a beholder's lair is warped by the creature's unnatural presence, which creates one or more of the following effects:

items: Creatures within 1 mile of Xanathar's lair sometimes feel as if they're being watched when they aren't.

When Xanathar sleeps, minor warps in reality occur within 1 mile of its lair and then vanish 24 hours later. Marks on cave walls might change subtly, an eerie trinket might appear where none existed before, harmless slime might coat a statue, and so on. These effects apply only to natural surfaces and to nonmagical objects that aren't on anyone's person.

regionalEffects: If Xanathar dies, these effects fade over the course of {@dice 1d10} days.

trait.name: Relentless Endurance
entries: When reduced to 0 hit points, Yagra drops to 1 hit point instead (but can't do this again until she finishes a long rest).

entries: Yagra has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of her allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Savage Attacks
entries: When she scores a critical hit Yagra can roll one of the weapon's damage dice and add it to the extra damage of the critical hit.

trait.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: While the adept is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: The adept wears a {@item teleporter ring|WDH}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The adept makes three unarmed strikes or three dart attacks.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, the adept can choose one of the following additional effects:

items: The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or drop one item it is holding (adept's choice).
The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.
The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the adept's next turn.

action.name: Dart
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Deflect Missile
entries: In response to being hit by a ranged weapon attack, the adept deflects the missile. The damage it takes from the attack is reduced by {@dice 1d10 + 3}. If the damage is reduced to 0, the adept catches the missile if it's small enough to hold in one hand and the adept has a hand free.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Ziraj is a 10th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma. He has the following paladin spells prepared:

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ziraj makes three attacks with his glaive or with his oversized longbow.

action.name: Glaive
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Oversized Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Dreadful Aspect (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: Ziraj exudes magical menace. Each enemy within 30 feet of him must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute of Ziraj. If a {@condition frightened} enemy ends its turn more than 30 feet away from Ziraj, the enemy can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.
